## Example Usage - Designcenter Catalog Template Revision Basic


```hcl
resource "google_design_center_catalog_template_revision" "example" {
  project          = "my-project-name"
  location         = "us-central1"
  space            = "example-space"
  catalog          = "example-catalog"
  catalog_template = "example-catalog-template"
  revision_id      = "example-revision"
  description      = "Example catalog template revision"
  type             = "SERVICE"

  git_source {
    repo    = "GoogleCloudPlatform/terraform-google-cloud-run"
    dir     = "modules/v2"
    ref_tag = "v0.15.2"
  }
}
```

## Argument Reference

The following arguments are supported:


* `location` -
  (Required)
  The location of the resource.

* `space` -
  (Required)
  The space of the resource.

* `catalog` -
  (Required)
  The catalog of the resource.

* `catalog_template` -
  (Required)
  The catalog template of the resource.

* `revision_id` -
  (Required)
  The ID of the revision.


* `description` -
  (Optional)
  The description of the revision.

* `type` -
  (Optional)
  The type of the component template revision.

* `git_source` -
  (Optional)
  Git repository source for the template revision.
  Structure is [documented below](#nested_git_source).

* `application_template_revision_source` -
  (Optional)
  The application template revision source URI.

* `annotations` -
  (Optional)
  The annotations of the revision.
  **Note**: This field is non-authoritative, and will only manage the annotations present in your configuration.
  Please refer to the field `effective_annotations` for all of the annotations present on the resource.

* `project` - (Optional) The ID of the project in which the resource belongs.
    If it is not provided, the provider project is used.

* `deletion_policy` - (Optional) Whether Terraform will be prevented from destroying the resource. Defaults to DELETE.
	When a 'terraform destroy' or 'terraform apply' would delete the resource,
	the command will fail if this field is set to "PREVENT" in Terraform state.
	When set to "ABANDON", the command will remove the resource from Terraform
	management without updating or deleting the resource in the API.
	When set to "DELETE", deleting the resource is allowed.


<a name="nested_git_source"></a>The `git_source` block supports:

* `repo` -
  (Required)
  The Git repository URI.

* `dir` -
  (Optional)
  The directory path within the Git repository.

* `ref_tag` -
  (Required)
  The Git reference tag or branch.

* `commit_sha` -
  (Output)
  The commit SHA resolved from the reference tag.

## Attributes Reference

In addition to the arguments listed above, the following computed attributes are exported:

* `id` - an identifier for the resource with format `projects/{{project}}/locations/{{location}}/spaces/{{space}}/catalogs/{{catalog}}/templates/{{catalog_template}}/revisions/{{revision_id}}`

* `name` -
  The resource name of the revision.

* `state` -
  The state of the revision.

* `uuid` -
  The unique identifier of the revision.

* `template_category` -
  The category of the parent catalog template.

* `create_time` -
  The creation time of the revision.

* `update_time` -
  The last update time of the revision.

* `effective_annotations` -
  All of annotations (key/value pairs) present on the resource in GCP, including the annotations configured through Terraform, other clients and services.

This resource provides the following

## Import


CatalogTemplateRevision can be imported using any of these accepted formats:

* `projects/{{project}}/locations/{{location}}/spaces/{{space}}/catalogs/{{catalog}}/templates/{{catalog_template}}/revisions/{{revision_id}}`
* `{{project}}/{{location}}/{{space}}/{{catalog}}/{{catalog_template}}/{{revision_id}}`
* `{{location}}/{{space}}/{{catalog}}/{{catalog_template}}/{{revision_id}}`

In Terraform v1.12.0 and later, use an [`identity` block](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/block/import#identity) to import CatalogTemplateRevision using identity values. For example:

```tf
import {
  identity = {
    location = "<-required value->"
    space = "<-required value->"
    catalog = "<-required value->"
    catalog_template = "<-required value->"
    revision_id = "<-required value->"
    project = "<-optional value->"
  }
  to = google_design_center_catalog_template_revision.default
}
```

In Terraform v1.5.0 and later, use an [`import` block](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/import) to import CatalogTemplateRevision using one of the formats above. For example:

```tf
import {
  id = "projects/{{project}}/locations/{{location}}/spaces/{{space}}/catalogs/{{catalog}}/templates/{{catalog_template}}/revisions/{{revision_id}}"
  to = google_design_center_catalog_template_revision.default
}
```

When using the [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import), CatalogTemplateRevision can be imported using one of the formats above. For example:

```
$ terraform import google_design_center_catalog_template_revision.default projects/{{project}}/locations/{{location}}/spaces/{{space}}/catalogs/{{catalog}}/templates/{{catalog_template}}/revisions/{{revision_id}}
$ terraform import google_design_center_catalog_template_revision.default {{project}}/{{location}}/{{space}}/{{catalog}}/{{catalog_template}}/{{revision_id}}
$ terraform import google_design_center_catalog_template_revision.default {{location}}/{{space}}/{{catalog}}/{{catalog_template}}/{{revision_id}}
```
